v1_boundary.outer_fold_safety: v1 fold-k only; residual trains fold!=k; evaluates fold k

arms.C: prototype residual, same beta candidates and same selection rule

beta_selection.inner_split: per outer fold, label-stratified 20% inner validation; fixed seed 20260905+fold
beta_selection.rule: eligible if inner AUPRC >= baseline-0.002 and inner Brier <= baseline+0.002; choose max inner MCC; ties choose smaller beta
beta_selection.fallback: if none eligible, choose smallest beta
beta_selection.post_rule: beta search stops after this protocol
